reading: Busted star James Bourne says his brother saved his life by donating a kidney.
Doctors had warned him that his condition was serious and that he had only a few years left to live.
In September 2025, the guitarist withdrew from a tour with Busted and McFly just one day before it began.
Because of James’s health problems, his younger brother Chris replaced him.
James later explained that he needed major surgery, meaning a serious medical operation, to help him live longer.
Chris, who had already taken his place on tour, then donated one of his kidneys to James.
James has now thanked Chris and reported that both brothers are recovering after their operations.
James said he was surprised by how much better he was already beginning to feel.
However, he explained that he still needed more time to recover fully.
He has not shared further details about his condition.
Busted had four UK number one singles before splitting up in 2005, and the full group reunited in 2015.

vocabulary.definition: Giving something, such as a part of your body, to help another person.
A health problem or illness affecting someone.
Decided not to take part in a planned activity.
Took another person’s role or position.
Serious or involving a lot of medical treatment, when describing an operation.
Becoming healthy again after an illness or operation.
Came together again after a period apart.

entries.ja: ほかの人を助けるために、自分の体の一部などを提供すること。
entries.ko: 다른 사람을 돕기 위해 자신의 신체 일부와 같은 것을 주는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了帮助他人而捐出某样东西，例如自己身体的一部分。
entries.es: Dar algo, como una parte del propio cuerpo, para ayudar a otra persona.
entries.pt-BR: Dar algo, como uma parte do próprio corpo, para ajudar outra pessoa.
entries.fr: Donner quelque chose, comme une partie de son corps, pour aider une autre personne.
entries.de: Etwas, zum Beispiel einen Teil des eigenen Körpers, geben, um einem anderen Menschen zu helfen.

entries.ja: ある人が抱えている健康上の問題や病気。
entries.ko: 누군가가 겪고 있는 건강 문제나 질병.
entries.zh-Hans: 某人出现的健康问题或患有的疾病。
entries.es: Un problema de salud o una enfermedad que afecta a alguien.
entries.pt-BR: Um problema de saúde ou uma doença que afeta alguém.
entries.fr: Un problème de santé ou une maladie dont souffre une personne.
entries.de: Ein gesundheitliches Problem oder eine Krankheit, die jemanden betrifft.

entries.ja: 予定されていた活動に参加しないと決めた。
entries.zh-Hans: 决定不参加原定的活动。
entries.es: Decidió no participar en una actividad prevista.
entries.pt-BR: Decidiu não participar de uma atividade planejada.
entries.fr: A décidé de ne pas participer à une activité prévue.
entries.de: Entschied sich, an einer geplanten Aktivität nicht teilzunehmen.

entries.ja: ほかの人の役割や立場を引き継いだ。
entries.ko: 다른 사람의 역할이나 자리를 대신 맡았다.
entries.zh-Hans: 接替了另一个人的角色或职位。
entries.es: Asumió el papel o el puesto de otra persona.
entries.pt-BR: Assumiu a função ou o lugar de outra pessoa.
entries.fr: A assumé le rôle ou occupé le poste d'une autre personne.
entries.de: Übernahm die Rolle oder Position einer anderen Person.

entries.ja: 手術について、重大なもの、または多くの医療処置を伴うものを指す。
entries.ko: 수술을 설명할 때, 중대하거나 많은 의료 처치가 필요한 것을 뜻한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 形容手术时，指手术重大或涉及大量医疗处置。
entries.es: Al describir una operación, indica que es seria o que implica mucho tratamiento médico.
entries.pt-BR: Ao descrever uma cirurgia, indica que ela é de grande porte ou envolve muito tratamento médico.
entries.fr: Se dit d'une opération lourde ou nécessitant de nombreux soins médicaux.
entries.de: Beschreibt eine Operation, die einen schweren Eingriff darstellt oder mit einer umfangreichen medizinischen Behandlung verbunden ist.

entries.ja: 病気や手術の後、再び健康になりつつあること。
entries.ko: 질병이나 수술 후에 다시 건강해지고 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在患病或接受手术后，正在逐渐恢复健康。
entries.es: Estar recuperando la salud después de una enfermedad o una operación.
entries.pt-BR: Estar recuperando a saúde após uma doença ou cirurgia.
entries.fr: Être en train de retrouver la santé après une maladie ou une opération.
entries.de: Nach einer Krankheit oder Operation allmählich wieder gesund werden.

entries.ja: ある事柄についての、さらに具体的な情報。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 관한 더 구체적인 정보.
entries.zh-Hans: 关于某件事的更具体的信息。
entries.fr: Des informations plus précises sur quelque chose.

entries.ja: しばらく離れていた後、再び集まった。
entries.zh-Hans: 分开一段时间后又重新聚到了一起。
entries.es: Volvieron a reunirse después de un tiempo separados.
entries.pt-BR: Voltaram a se reunir depois de um período separados.
entries.fr: Se sont retrouvés après une période de séparation.
entries.de: Kamen nach einer Zeit der Trennung wieder zusammen.
